items:
Summary:

Welcome to your Grayton Beach retreat, where coastal living come together just steps from the sand. This home makes it simple to gather and unwind between outings.



- Sleeps 26 | 8 bedrooms | 14 beds | 8.5 baths

- Private pool & hot tub - pool heat seasonal (fee applies)

- Rooftop deck, balconies & outdoor lounge w/ fire pit

- Game room w/ pool table & wet bar

- Chef’s kitchen, elevator & beach access

- Free parking & self check-in



The Space:

Morning light filters through expansive windows as the Gulf breeze drifts in, carrying the quiet rhythm of waves just beyond the street. Soft Gulf light fills the rooms as sea air drifts through open balconies, setting an easy rhythm for days spent between sand and neighborhood streets.



The space

Set just steps from the sand in the Grayton Beach community of Santa Rosa Beach, this newly constructed home is designed for large gatherings with room to spread out and reconnect. The layout spans three levels with open living areas that flow naturally outdoors. White oak hardwood floors, imported tile, and custom finishes appear throughout, reflecting the thoughtful craftsmanship of the build.



Living, kitchen, and gathering spaces

Shared spaces anchor the home and encourage time together. A game room with a pool table opens to a comfortable living area with a wet bar and direct access to the backyard. Upstairs, the kitchen and main living area create a central hub for meals and downtime. The chef’s kitchen features GE Monogram appliances, ample refrigeration, and space to cook for groups, with dining and seating areas nearby and balconies extending the living space outside.



Sleeping arrangements

The home sleeps up to 26 guests across eight private bedroom suites, each with its own bath for added comfort and privacy. Bedrooms are distributed across all floors, balancing quiet retreats with easy access to shared spaces. King bedrooms are complemented by two bunk bedrooms designed to accommodate larger groups without crowding.



Outdoor living

Outdoor spaces are woven into every level of the home. Multiple balconies and a rooftop deck offer elevated places to enjoy coastal air and sunset views. The backyard centers around a private pool and hot tub, with outdoor seating, a fire pit, and grilling space for relaxed evenings. Pool heat is seasonal and available by request for an additional fee.



Amenities and convenience

An elevator serves all floors, and the home includes air conditioning, heating, WiFi, a dedicated workspace, washer and dryer, beach access, and beach essentials. Free parking on premises and self check-in with a smart lock make arrivals easy. Long-term stays are allowed. Pets are not permitted. A Golf Cart (LSV) rental partner discount is available.



Neighborhood

Grayton Beach is known for its creative spirit and walkable mix of restaurants, bars, and local shops. From beach days and nearby state parks to evenings exploring the local food scene, Santa Rosa Beach offers a relaxed pace with plenty to enjoy year-round.



Guest Access:

We offer convenient door codes for self-check-in. 850 Vacations by Portoro uses convenient keyless entry for self check-in, details provided 2 weeks (or less) prior to arrival by email and text message.



• Early check-ins or late check-outs: If the property happens to be ready earlier than the standard 4 pm check-in time on the day of your arrival, in most cases an early arrival option may be available when confirmed with the main office. Late check-outs must be confirmed with main office staff prior to the date of departure.



Available for Events (See Other Things to Note for fees/terms.)

- Weddings

- Reunions

- Corporate Functions

- Multiple Family Gatherings



Golf Cart (Low Speed Vehicle, "LSV") Rental Discount

- Portoro has partnered with Destin Florida Golf Cart Rentals, LLC to offer our guests 15% Off their golf cart (Low Speed Vehicle) rental! Contact details and pricing for Destin Florida Golf Cart Rentals, LLC will be listed at the property and in your check-in details.



The Neighborhood:

South Walton County's Santa Rosa Beach is located along Florida's Northwest Coast, just east of Destin. One of the oldest 30A coastal towns. You'll enjoy gorgeous state parks, delicious restaurants, and a thriving region for artists. Out of the water? Parks, museums, local galleries, and family-friendly adventures await! With fishing, scuba diving, snorkeling and sand castles, Santa Rosa Beach is the ultimate 30A beach vacation experience!



Things to See:

• Local Experiences:

• Local Restaurants & Shopping

- Restaurants: Bud and Alley's Waterfront Restaurant and Rooftop Bar, Hooked Sea to Table, Down Island Gulf Seafood Restaurant, Louis Louis, The Bay

- Shops: The District, Retail Therapy of Santa Rosa Beach, Uptown Grayton, Gulf Place Town Center, Seagrove Plaza & more!



Annual Festivals & Events:

• The Big Chill on 30a

• 30A Songwriters Festival

• Sandestin Gumbo Festival

• South Walton Beaches Wine & Food Festival

• WaterColor Film Festival

• Harvest Wine and Food Festival

• Fourth of July on 30A

• Gulf Coast Jam



We provide a full list of Things to Do & See and local Restaurants & Shops to experience for our guests including in a personalized Guest Manual in your check-in details provided prior to your stay!



S. Walton County (Miramar Beach, FL) Short-Term Rental Registration No. #



Getting Around:

You'll find that Santa Rosa Beach provides easy access to dining, shopping, and nightlife entertainment. Guests have access to several beaches in the region! Bikes/Cycling or taking public transportation are alternate options (Major corridors in close proximity to South Walton include: I-65, I-55, I-10, and US Hwy 331). While you may be traveling by your/rental vehicle, if you need additional transportation or nearest airport information, we have you covered!



Traveling to/around Santa Rosa Beach, Florida:

• Taxi Cabs [i.e., Panhandle Transportation Group, Miramar Beach Shuttle, Marcowhale Limo Shuttle and Tax Service]

• Uber, Lyft

• Bike/Cycling [Rentals: Coastal Cruisers, Fun Pug Bike Rentals, Runaway Rentals, Sweet Escape Rentals]



Airports:

• Destin-Fort Walton Beach Airport (VPS) [35 miles north-northwest of downtown Destin]

• Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport (ECP) [35 miles east of Destin]



Popular Landmarks:

• Grayton Beach State Park

• Topsail Hill Preserve State Park

• Shell Island

• Fort Walton Heritage Park and Cultural Center

• Deer Lake State Park

• Seaside Beach



Interaction with Guests:

Our goal is that your vacation exceed your expectations. 850 Vacations by Portoro communicates via email and phone. After a booking is confirmed, rental agreement will be emailed to the guest for e-signature. Check-in instructions are sent by email and text message 14 days (or less) prior to arrival date. We offer convenient keyless entry for self-check in. We do typically check in with guests by text 1-2 times during their stays to ensure a 5-star experience and remain available for any questions. We are available to guests 24/7 for any inquiries.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
